level.title: Intermediate Urdu
goals: Communicate connected ideas accurately for the level.
Adapt register and structure to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Urdu with script, romanisation, and cultural awareness.

lessons.title: Connected health explanations
lessons.learn: Build connected speech with reasons, time reference, obligation, and respectful interaction. The focus is moving beyond isolated phrases while keeping the message clear. This lesson applies that control to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Connected health explanations — discourse control
grammar.explain: Build connected speech with reasons, time reference, obligation, and respectful interaction. The focus is moving beyond isolated phrases while keeping the message clear.
grammar.pattern: context + main point + support/qualification + audience-appropriate close
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically; preserve natural Urdu verb-final structure and match respect, gender, and number to the context.

practice.q: Translate precisely: آنکھوں کا ڈاکٹر (aankhon ka doctor)
Write the Urdu term for: children's doctor
Produce this complete Urdu model: I am not feeling well
practice.answer: مجھے اچھا نہیں لگ رہا (Mujhe achha nahi lag raha)
